description: This file defines a Java interface 'ZigbeeStatusListener' with a single method 'statusChanged', which likely serves as a callback for changes in Zigbee device status within the system.

classes.name: ZigbeeStatusListener
classes.description: An interface for listening to status changes in Zigbee devices, providing a callback method 'statusChanged' that indicates whether the device is running or not.

methods.name: statusChanged
methods.description: Method invoked to notify implementing classes that the status has changed; parameter 'running' indicates the new status (true for running, false for not).
